text: {"label":"Clinical Service Delivery and Care Systems","definition":"Work on how clinical behavioral services are organized and delivered: data-based decisions, clinician training systems, consent and assent, insurance and legal requirements, quality metrics, integrated healthcare collaboration, and research within patient care.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on systems, administration, and ethics of delivering clinical care, not treatment fidelity and acceptability, clinical behavior analysis as psychotherapy, or descriptions of specific intervention programs."}
